episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Yeong-ro and Soo-ho meet in a group blind date and fall in love.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Yeong-ro and the students find an injured Soo-ho, who is wanted by authorities.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Yeong-ro takes care of the injured Soo-ho and tries to find a way to sneak him out of the dormitory.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Soo-ho's whereabouts are tracked by Lee Gang-mu.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Soo-ho engages the head of the National Security Agency in negotiations to escape with his comrades.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Soo-ho continues to take students hostage, turning a blind eye to Yeong-ro who feels betrayed.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Soo-ho's and Yeong-ro's fates become entangled amid a vicious battle of deceit.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Soo-ho's heart breaks for Yeong-ro as the hostage crisis makes nationwide news.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Young Ro loses faith in Soo Ho and plans an escape with Lee Gang Moo.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Hannah sets out to find the secret behind the hostage crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Soo-ho embarks on a path to regain trust when the truth about the hostage crisis emerges.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Soo-ho and Yeong-ro lean on each other in a situation where no one can be trusted.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Students are confused about which side to trust amid the National Security Agency's operation.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Soo-ho is heartbroken to see Yeong-ro struggle from her bad news.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Soo-ho has no choice but to accept the head of the National Security Agency's proposal.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Soo-ho stands at the crossroads of fate.
